llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及任何人工智能方法，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI or machine learning into any stage of bioprinting; it is purely a hardware/methodology study.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善3D生物打印结构中的营养输送
summary_zh.method: 使用同轴喷嘴打印内置微通道
summary_zh.result: 成功制造出含微通道的生物打印结构

summary_en.motivation: To enhance nutrient delivery within 3D bioprinted constructs by incorporating microchannels.
summary_en.method: A coaxial nozzle-assisted bioprinting approach was employed to fabricate constructs with built-in microchannels.
summary_en.result: Constructs with well-defined microchannels were successfully printed, showing improved nutrient diffusion.
summary_en.validation: In vitro testing demonstrated enhanced cell viability and nutrient transport in microchanneled constructs compared to non-channeled controls.

papers.title: Particulate migration behavior and its mechanism during selective laser melting of TiC reinforced Al matrix nanocomposites
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Yudao Street 29, Nanjing 210016, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Dongdong Gu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Yudao Street 29, Nanjing 210016, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钛碳化物增强铝基纳米复合材料的选区激光熔化，不涉及生物医学植入物或应力遮挡。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue, or osseointegration; it focuses on particle migration in aluminum matrix composites for non-biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究钛碳化物颗粒在铝基复合材料激光熔化中的迁移行为。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备TiC/Al纳米复合材料并分析颗粒运动。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了颗粒迁移机制及其对微观结构的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观表征和力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to understand the migration behavior of TiC particles during selective laser melting of aluminum matrix nanocomposites.
summary_en.method: TiC-reinforced Al matrix nanocomposites were fabricated by selective laser melting, and particle migration mechanisms were investigated through microstructural analysis.
summary_en.result: The migration mechanism of TiC particles was elucidated, showing its influence on the composite microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
